escenas.texto: This week in Europe, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over two hundred and seventy-eight million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Europe edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Europe. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Wednesday. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, from United Kingdom, Premier League, with “MAX DOWMAN The Youngest Goalscorer In Premier League History!”. Over seven point two million views. A Short of just sixteen seconds. It also has four hundred and seventy-six comments.

Number nine, Unspoken Stories, with “Nobody Believed Him At First His Whole Life Vanished When He Woke Up”. Over seven point three million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety-eight thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.
In position number eight, FORMULA 1, with “Race Highlights 2026 United States Grand Prix”. Over seven point five million views. It got there in just two days. It also has over two thousand comments.
At number seven, from Spain, Jajamaru, with a video posted six days ago. Over seven point nine million views. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds. It also has two hundred and ten comments.

Next up, number six, from United Kingdom, John Nellis, with “I Tested Footballer’s Lungs”. Over eight point nine million views. A Short of just forty-three seconds. It also has one hundred and two comments.

Next up, number five, from United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “6 ways iPhone Duo beats Samsung”. Over eleven million views. A Short of just fifty-four seconds. It also has over six thousand comments.

Next up, number four, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted four days ago. Over fifteen million views. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over twenty-five thousand comments.
Bronze medal, from Spain, YoSoyDander, with a video posted six days ago. Over fifteen million views. A Short of just nineteen seconds. It also has eighty-nine comments.
Silver medal, from Cyprus, crafter duck - DIY, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty million views. A Short of just forty-nine seconds. It also has two hundred and sixty-five comments.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, from United Kingdom, DAZN Football, with “2026 Ballon d'Or Red Carpet Pre Show”. Over twenty-one million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and forty thousand views per hour. A video over seventy-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Next up, number ten, from Türkiye, Bakirkertenkele31, with a video posted three days ago. Over four thousand comments. A video over thirty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one point four million views.

Coming in at number nine, from Ukraine, Domer Grief, with a video posted two days ago. Over five thousand comments. A video over twenty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.
Next up, number eight, Vsauce, with “The Magic Octagon”. Over six thousand comments. It also has over four point eight million views.
In position number seven, from Poland, Czajnik, with a video posted five days ago. Over seven thousand comments. It also has over one point two million views.

In position number six, Unspoken Stories, with “Nobody Believed Him At First His Whole Life Vanished When He Woke Up”. Over eight thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety-eight thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over seven point three million views.

Next up, number five, from United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “iPhone Duo is Messier Than You Think”. Over eleven thousand comments. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over ten million views.

Next up, number four, from United Kingdom, Beta Squad, with “Beta squad mafia play-along edition”. Over twelve thousand comments. A video over eighty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over four point six million views.

Bronze medal, from Türkiye, Vural Üzül, with a video posted four days ago. Over fourteen thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: fifteen out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over forty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Silver medal, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty-five thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Drum roll, please. Number one most commented, from United Kingdom, The Diary Of A CEO, with a video posted five days ago. Over forty-five thousand comments. A video over one hundred and nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five point one million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. At number ten, from Cyprus, crafter duck - DIY, with a video posted four days ago. Over one hundred and fifty-nine thousand likes. A Short of just forty-nine seconds. It also has over twenty million views.

At number nine, from United Kingdom, The Diary Of A CEO, with a video posted five days ago. Over one hundred and seventy-three thousand likes. A video over one hundred and nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five point one million views.

Next up, number eight, from United Kingdom, DAZN Football, with “2026 Ballon d'Or Red Carpet Pre Show”. Over two hundred and four thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and forty thousand views per hour. A video over seventy-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
At number seven, BAS Renovations , with “Are your gutters installed right?”. Over two hundred and six thousand likes. It also has over four point nine million views.

Coming in at number six, Jack Overton PT, with “Something’s gonna go pop”. Over two hundred and seventy-three thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-six thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over five million views.

Number five, Vsauce, with “The Magic Octagon”. Over three hundred and five thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over four point eight million views.

Number four, from Spain, Jajamaru, with a video posted six days ago. Over three hundred and twenty-six thousand likes. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds. It also has over seven point nine million views.

Bronze medal, from United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “6 ways iPhone Duo beats Samsung”. Over three hundred and forty-six thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-four seconds. It also has over eleven million views.

Silver medal, Unspoken Stories, with “Nobody Believed Him At First His Whole Life Vanished When He Woke Up”. Over three hundred and forty-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety-eight thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over seven point three million views.

And here it is. Number one most liked, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted four days ago. Over four hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over fifteen million views.

And some news: starting week forty-five we add TikTok. The ten most viral TikTok videos of the week, right here too. Don't miss it. And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: the Americas. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Europe every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
